snippet.title: Alone in the Dark: Inferno (2008) - Full Game Longplay Walkthrough + All Endings (PS3 Gameplay)
snippet.description:
Full longplay / playthrough of Alone in the Dark: Inferno, released in 2008 for Playstation 3. This is an updated and extended version of Alone in the Dark 2008, released for Xbox 360, PC, PS2 and Wii 5 months earlier. Recorded on a real PS3.
Support the channel on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/neogamertvga
